content: Clinical Skills Online (CSO) is an initiative developed by the Educational Technology Unit at St George's, University of London, UK. Its purpose is to provide online video demonstrations of fundamental clinical skills that are relevant to a broad spectrum of medical and health-related courses in higher education. These videos are accessible for free, but they are intended solely for educational, personal, and non-commercial use. All materials on the CSO website, including text, images, videos, and other original content, are licensed under the Creative Commons unless explicitly stated otherwise. It is important to note that the clinical skills videos on the CSO platform have been designed at a foundational level to cater to a wide range of medical and healthcare disciplines, with the goal of sharing knowledge with the broader community. Additionally, users should be aware that there may be minor differences in the procedures demonstrated in the videos, as these can vary between institutions due to differences in policies and the equipment utilized.
